title: Sandbox Dockerfile is on node:20-slim (EOL 2026-04-30), though #1038 moved it to Node 22 in 2025

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue clearly identifies that the Dockerfile and container images are using node:20-slim, which reached end-of-life on 2026-04-30. It provides specific line references from Dockerfile and requests upgrading to an active Node LTS release (Node 22). This is a valid, clear, and actionable issue.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: Updating the base image version from node:20-slim to node:22-slim in Dockerfile and .gcp/Dockerfile.development is a straightforward base image configuration update.

summary.problem: The repository Dockerfiles use node:20-slim base image, which reached end-of-life on 2026-04-30 and no longer receives security updates.
summary.root_cause: The base image in Dockerfile and .gcp/Dockerfile.development is explicitly pinned to docker.io/library/node:20-slim.
summary.context: Upgrading the Docker base image to node:22-slim resolves security vulnerabilities and ensures the sandbox environment runs on an active Node LTS version.

steps: In Dockerfile, change 'FROM docker.io/library/node:20-slim AS builder' to 'FROM docker.io/library/node:22-slim AS builder'.
In Dockerfile, change 'FROM docker.io/library/node:20-slim' to 'FROM docker.io/library/node:22-slim'.
In .gcp/Dockerfile.development, change 'FROM docker.io/library/node:20-slim AS base' to 'FROM docker.io/library/node:22-slim AS base'.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: The Docker container images build successfully and run with Node 22 runtime.
verification_steps: Build the Docker sandbox image with 'docker build -t gemini-cli-sandbox .'.
Run 'docker run --rm gemini-cli-sandbox node -v' to confirm the container runs Node 22.
